blocks.zh: BSC 與隔離器模擬設備的重要考量 | pp. 43–45
blocks.en: Key considerations for BSC and isolator mock-ups | pp. 43–45

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 核心概念
blocks.en: Commentary: Core Concepts

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要 Mock-Up（模擬設備）？
blocks.en: Why Do We Need a Mock-Up?

blocks.zh: Mock-up 是在正式設備製造或採購前，以木材、紙板或等比例實物模型，模擬操作員在隔離器或生物安全櫃內實際執行無菌操作的過程。
blocks.en: A mock-up uses wood, cardboard or full-scale physical models to simulate how operators will actually perform aseptic operations inside an isolator or biosafety cabinet, before the real equipment is manufactured or purchased.

blocks.zh: ATMP 製程涉及大量手動操作（細胞培養轉移、注射器填充、容器開閉），這些動作必須在 Grade A 環境下完成，且不得破壞 first air（第一道無菌氣流）。任何設計缺陷，一旦設備製造完成，改正成本極高。
blocks.en: ATMP processes involve a great deal of manual manipulation (cell culture transfers, syringe filling, opening and closing of containers). These actions must be performed in a grade A environment without disrupting first air (the first unidirectional flow of sterile air). Once the equipment has been built, correcting any design flaw is extremely expensive.

blocks.zh: 隔離器：手套口位置安裝後幾乎無法更動，因此在設計階段就必須透過 mock-up 確認所有操作角度
blocks.en: Isolators: glove port positions can hardly be changed once installed, so all working angles must be confirmed through a mock-up at the design stage

blocks.zh: BSC：設計較標準，但仍需確認所選尺寸適合製程需求
blocks.en: BSCs: the design is more standardized, but you still need to confirm that the selected size suits the process requirements

blocks.zh: 比喻：外科手術訓練模擬器
blocks.en: Analogy: a surgical training simulator

blocks.zh: 外科醫師在進行腹腔鏡手術訓練時，先用模擬器練習器械的角度與力道，確認手感正確後才進行真實手術。Mock-up 就是製藥設備的「手術模擬器」——在實物設備鑄造前，先用低成本模型驗證每一個動作的可行性。
blocks.en: Before performing real laparoscopic surgery, a surgeon first practices instrument angles and force on a simulator, and operates on a patient only once the feel is right. A mock-up is the "surgical simulator" of pharmaceutical equipment: before the real equipment is fabricated, a low-cost model is used to verify that every movement is feasible.

blocks.zh: 一個手套位置設計錯誤，可能導致操作員在執行關鍵步驟時手臂橫越開放容器上方，直接違反 first air 原則，引發微生物污染風險。
blocks.en: A single misplaced glove position can force the operator to reach over an open container during a critical step. This directly violates the first air principle and creates a risk of microbial contamination.

blocks.zh: ATMP 特殊考量
blocks.en: ATMP-Specific Considerations

blocks.zh: ATMP 製程時間通常遠長於一般小分子藥物，操作員可能需要在手套箱內連續操作數小時。Mock-up 必須評估：
blocks.en: ATMP processes usually run much longer than those for conventional small-molecule drugs, and operators may need to work continuously in the glove box for hours. The mock-up must evaluate:

blocks.zh: 長時間操作的疲勞與人因工學（ergonomics）
blocks.en: Fatigue and ergonomics during prolonged operation

blocks.zh: 個體差異：不同身高、慣用手的操作員是否都能安全執行
blocks.en: Individual variation: whether operators of different heights and handedness can all work safely

blocks.zh: 複雜操作序列（如細胞計數、分裝、封口）的連貫性
blocks.en: The continuity of complex operation sequences (such as cell counting, dispensing and closing)

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 操作員參與與迭代
blocks.en: Commentary: Operator Involvement and Iteration

blocks.zh: 比喻：汽車碰撞測試假人
blocks.en: Analogy: car crash-test dummies

blocks.zh: 汽車安全測試使用假人代替真人進行碰撞，在車輛量產前發現設計缺陷。實體 mock-up 扮演相同角色：以低成本模型（木材、紙板）代替昂貴的不鏽鋼設備，在確定設計前捕捉所有人因工學問題。
blocks.en: Car safety tests use dummies instead of people in crash tests, so that design flaws are found before the vehicle goes into mass production. A physical mock-up plays the same role: a low-cost model (wood, cardboard) stands in for expensive stainless steel equipment, so that all ergonomic issues are caught before the design is fixed.

blocks.zh: 一旦隔離器製造完成，改變手套口位置可能需要數週停機和數十萬美元費用。Mock-up 就是那個「在焊接前就找出問題」的工具。
blocks.en: Once an isolator has been built, changing a glove port position can mean weeks of downtime and hundreds of thousands of dollars. A mock-up is the tool that "finds the problem before the welding is done."

blocks.zh: 重點：為何需要至少兩名操作員
blocks.en: Key point: why at least two operators are needed

blocks.zh: 執行操作的人往往無法察覺自己的違規動作（例如手臂不自覺地越過開放容器）。第二人的「觀察員」角色，相當於 aseptic process simulation（APS）中的觀察記錄員，其目的相同：捕捉第一人的視覺盲點。這個原則貫穿整個無菌製造生命週期。
blocks.en: The person performing the operation often cannot notice their own non-compliant movements (for example, an arm unconsciously passing over an open container). The second person, the observer, is equivalent to the observer/recorder in an aseptic process simulation (APS) and serves the same purpose: to catch the first person's blind spots. This principle runs through the entire aseptic manufacturing lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 圖示說明與應用解析
blocks.en: Commentary: Figure Explanation and Application

blocks.zh: 圖 5.1-1 電腦模擬 Mock-Up 解析
blocks.en: Figure 5.1-1 Computer-Simulated Mock-Up

blocks.zh: 電腦模擬 Mock-Up 是設計最初期的工具。3D CAD 模型允許工程師在圖紙階段就測試：
blocks.en: The computer-simulated mock-up is the earliest design-stage tool. A 3D CAD model allows engineers to test, at the drawing stage:

blocks.zh: 手套口位置：對應不同身高操作員的舒適觸及範圍（reach zone）
blocks.en: Glove port position: comfortable reach zones for operators of different heights

blocks.zh: 設備干涉：是否有管路、感測器或設備遮擋操作路徑
blocks.en: Equipment interference: whether piping, sensors or equipment block the working path

blocks.zh: First air 覆蓋：產品接觸表面是否始終在 HEPA 下方的層流區域內
blocks.en: First air coverage: whether product-contact surfaces always stay within the HEPA-fed unidirectional airflow zone

blocks.zh: 此階段修改成本最低，僅需修改數位模型。
blocks.en: At this stage the cost of change is lowest, since only the digital model needs to be modified.

blocks.zh: 圖 5.1-2 VR Mock-Up 解析
blocks.en: Figure 5.1-2 VR Mock-Up

blocks.zh: VR Mock-Up 結合了電腦模擬的靈活性與接近實體的沉浸體驗。其特別價值在於：
blocks.en: The VR mock-up combines the flexibility of a computer simulation with an immersive, near-physical experience. Its particular value lies in:

blocks.zh: 動作序列測試：操作員在虛擬空間中真實演練整個製程，系統記錄每一個動作軌跡
blocks.en: Movement sequence testing: operators rehearse the whole process realistically in virtual space, and the system records every movement trajectory

blocks.zh: 遠端訓練：新設施尚未建成時，操作員可在現有地點提前接受訓練
blocks.en: Remote training: while the new facility is not yet built, operators can be trained in advance at an existing site

blocks.zh: 干預模擬：可安全測試緊急情境（如設備故障中的無菌干預）而不影響實際生產
blocks.en: Intervention simulation: emergency scenarios (such as an aseptic intervention during an equipment failure) can be tested safely without affecting actual production

blocks.zh: 對 ATMP CDMO 而言，VR mock-up 可加速 FAT（Factory Acceptance Testing）前的操作員培訓，縮短設備上線時間。
blocks.en: For an ATMP CDMO, a VR mock-up can accelerate operator training before FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) and shorten the time to put the equipment into service.

blocks.zh: 圖 5.1-3 實體 Mock-Up 解析
blocks.en: Figure 5.1-3 Physical Mock-Up

blocks.zh: 實體 Mock-Up 是最終確認工具，必須在正式設備訂購前完成。關鍵要求：
blocks.en: The physical mock-up is the final confirmation tool and must be completed before the actual equipment is ordered. Key requirements:

blocks.zh: 重量/力道代表性：最終階段的 mock-up 物件重量必須接近實際操作物（例如裝滿液體的注射器、細胞培養袋）
blocks.en: Representative weight and force: in the final-stage mock-up, the weight of the objects must be close to that of the real items handled (for example, a liquid-filled syringe or cell culture bag)

blocks.zh: 操作員多樣性：需由不同身高、慣用手的操作員測試，確保設備適用範圍
blocks.en: Operator diversity: it must be tested by operators of different heights and handedness to confirm the range of use of the equipment

blocks.zh: 正式記錄：結果必須文件化，成為設備確效包的一部分
blocks.en: Formal records: the results must be documented and become part of the equipment qualification package

blocks.zh: Rationale — 為何 ATMP 特別需要 Mock-Up
blocks.en: Rationale: Why ATMPs Particularly Need Mock-Ups

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1（2022 更新）及 PDA PtC-14 均強調：ATMP 製造涉及大量手動操作序列，且這些操作往往比傳統小分子藥物更為複雜。沒有經過充分 mock-up 測試的設備設計，其 default（預設）製程很可能在實際操作中妥協無菌性。
blocks.en: Both EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 revision) and PDA PtC-14 stress that ATMP manufacturing involves extensive manual operation sequences, which are often more complex than those for conventional small-molecule drugs. An equipment design that has not been adequately mock-up tested is likely to compromise sterility in its default process during actual operation.

blocks.zh: CDMO ATMP 情境練習
blocks.en: CDMO ATMP Scenario Exercise

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在為一個自體 T 細胞療法客戶安裝新的隔離器系統。供應商提供了 CAD 圖紙，但客戶要求在 FAT 前完成 mock-up 測試。請回答：
blocks.en: Your CDMO is installing a new isolator system for an autologous T-cell therapy client. The supplier has provided CAD drawings, but the client requires mock-up testing to be completed before FAT. Answer the following:

blocks.zh: 你會在哪個設計階段分別使用電腦、VR 和實體 mock-up？
blocks.en: At which design stage would you use the computer, VR and physical mock-ups respectively?

blocks.zh: 此 ATMP 製程需要操作員持拿 500 mL 細胞培養袋，在隔離器內進行 30 分鐘轉移操作。哪些人因工學因素最需要在 mock-up 中驗證？
blocks.en: This ATMP process requires the operator to hold a 500 mL cell culture bag and carry out a 30-minute transfer inside the isolator. Which ergonomic factors most need to be verified in the mock-up?

blocks.zh: Mock-up 測試完成後，發現左手操作員在轉移步驟中手臂會越過開放容器上方。在不大幅改變整體設計的前提下，你有哪些補救選項？
blocks.en: After mock-up testing, it is found that a left-handed operator's arm passes over an open container during the transfer step. Without substantially changing the overall design, what remedial options do you have?

blocks.zh: 隔離器與 BSC 腔體洩漏完整性測試頻率的差異 | pp. 46–47
blocks.en: Differences in leak integrity test frequency between isolator and BSC chambers | pp. 46–47

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 隔離器洩漏測試
blocks.en: Commentary: Isolator Leak Testing

blocks.zh: 為什麼隔離器需要高頻率洩漏測試？
blocks.en: Why do isolators need frequent leak testing?

blocks.zh: 隔離器是一個封閉系統（closed system）：其無菌性依賴於腔體的物理完整性。一旦任何部位洩漏，外部微生物或粒子就能進入 Grade A 環境，直接危及產品無菌性。因此，每次可能影響完整性的操作後，都必須重新確認。
blocks.en: An isolator is a closed system: its sterility depends on the physical integrity of the chamber. If any part leaks, external microorganisms or particles can enter the grade A environment and directly jeopardize product sterility. Integrity must therefore be reconfirmed after every operation that could affect it.

blocks.zh: 隔離器洩漏測試的觸發時機：
blocks.en: When isolator leak testing is triggered:

blocks.zh: 常規：每批次開始前和結束後
blocks.en: Routine: before the start and after the end of each batch

blocks.zh: 維護後：任何開蓋、更換零件、維修後
blocks.en: After maintenance: any opening, part replacement or repair

blocks.zh: 手套更換後：手套是最常見的完整性薄弱點
blocks.en: After glove changes: gloves are the most common integrity weak point

blocks.zh: 調查支援：發生不明微生物污染或病毒污染時
blocks.en: Investigation support: when unexplained microbial or viral contamination occurs

blocks.zh: 主要測試方法簡介
blocks.en: Overview of the Main Test Methods

blocks.zh:
壓力變化法 (Pressure-change method):
  - 原理：將腔體加壓（正壓隔離器）或抽真空（負壓），
    在規定時間內觀察壓力變化量
  - 接受標準：通常壓力變化 ≤ 0.25% / min（依 ISO 14644-7）
  - 優點：不需額外試劑，操作簡單，可頻繁執行

氧氣法 (Oxygen method — 負壓隔離器):
  - 原理：監測腔體內氧濃度變化，外部空氣滲入時
    O₂ 濃度上升，提示洩漏

示蹤氣體法 (Tracer gas method):
  - 原理：腔體內釋放示蹤氣體（如 He），外部偵測器
    測量是否有氣體逸出
  - 優點：高靈敏度，可定位洩漏點
  - 缺點：成本較高，需要專用設備
blocks.en:
Pressure-change method:
  - Principle: pressurize the chamber (positive-pressure isolator) or evacuate it (negative pressure),
    then observe the pressure change over a defined time
  - Acceptance criterion: usually pressure change ≤ 0.25% / min (per ISO 14644-7)
  - Advantages: no additional reagents, simple to perform, can be run frequently

Oxygen method (negative-pressure isolators):
  - Principle: monitor the change in oxygen concentration inside the chamber; when outside air
    leaks in, the O₂ concentration rises, indicating a leak

Tracer gas method:
  - Principle: release a tracer gas (e.g. He) inside the chamber and use an external detector
    to measure whether any gas escapes
  - Advantages: high sensitivity, can locate the leak point
  - Disadvantages: higher cost, requires dedicated equipment

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — BSC 的根本差異
blocks.en: Commentary: The Fundamental Difference of the BSC

blocks.zh: 開放系統 vs. 封閉系統 — 根本上的不同
blocks.en: Open system vs. closed system: a fundamental difference

blocks.zh: BSC（生物安全櫃）是開放系統：前方有一個開口（sash opening），操作員的手臂從此進入操作。這意味著它在物理上不可能完全密封，因此傳統壓力保持洩漏測試無法適用。
blocks.en: A BSC (biosafety cabinet) is an open system: it has an opening at the front (the sash opening) through which the operator's arms enter. This means it is physically impossible to seal completely, so conventional pressure-hold leak testing cannot be applied.

blocks.zh: BSC 的防護原理是氣流，而非物理屏障：
blocks.en: The BSC's protection principle is airflow, not a physical barrier:

blocks.zh: 向下的 HEPA 過濾氣流保護產品免受粒子污染
blocks.en: Downward HEPA-filtered airflow protects the product from particulate contamination

blocks.zh: 向內的氣流（inflow）防止內部危險物質逸出到操作員區域
blocks.en: Inward airflow (inflow) prevents hazardous materials inside from escaping into the operator's area

blocks.zh: 因此，BSC 的「完整性」測試，測的是氣流的有效性，而非物理密封性。
blocks.en: Therefore, "integrity" testing of a BSC tests the effectiveness of the airflow, not the physical tightness.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise

blocks.zh: 你的設施在一次批次生產中發現環境監測（EM）異常：隔離器腔體環境樣本出現一個菌落。你應該在失效調查中優先執行哪種測試，以確定污染是否來自腔體完整性失效？請說明具體測試方法及其對後續批次放行決策的影響。
blocks.en: During a production batch, your facility finds an environmental monitoring (EM) excursion: an isolator chamber environmental sample shows one colony. Which test should you prioritize in the failure investigation to determine whether the contamination came from a loss of chamber integrity? Explain the specific test method and its impact on the subsequent batch release decision.

blocks.zh: BSC 與隔離器氣流可視化（煙霧研究）的異同 | pp. 47–50
blocks.en: Differences and similarities in airflow visualization (smoke studies) between BSCs and isolators | pp. 47–50

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 煙霧研究核心概念
blocks.en: Commentary: Core Concepts of Smoke Studies

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要煙霧研究？
blocks.en: Why are smoke studies needed?

blocks.zh: 氣流在正常狀態下是不可見的。HEPA 過濾器提供潔淨空氣，但這股氣流是否真的以正確方向、正確速度流過產品表面，是無法用肉眼判斷的。
blocks.en: Airflow is invisible under normal conditions. A HEPA filter supplies clean air, but whether this air actually flows across the product surfaces in the right direction and at the right velocity cannot be judged by eye.

blocks.zh: 煙霧研究（smoke study / airflow visualization）使用無害的煙霧示蹤劑，將氣流的流向、速度和擾動視覺化，確認設備在設計和操作狀態下均符合 Grade A 要求。
blocks.en: A smoke study (airflow visualization) uses a harmless smoke tracer to visualize the direction, velocity and disturbance of the airflow, confirming that the equipment meets grade A requirements in both its design and operating states.

blocks.zh: 煙霧研究是 EU GMP Annex 1（2022）的強制要求，必須在 at-rest 和 in-operation 兩種狀態下執行。
blocks.en: Smoke studies are a mandatory requirement of EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) and must be performed in both the at-rest and in-operation states.

blocks.zh: 隔離器煙霧研究的核心目標
blocks.en: Core Objectives of Isolator Smoke Studies

blocks.zh: 隔離器的目的是保護產品（product protection）。因此煙霧研究的核心問題是：
blocks.en: The purpose of an isolator is to protect the product (product protection). The core questions of the smoke study are therefore:

blocks.zh: HEPA 的第一道潔淨氣流是否直接覆蓋所有產品接觸表面？
blocks.en: Does the first clean airflow from the HEPA directly cover all product-contact surfaces?

blocks.zh: 氣流是否形成「掃越動作（sweeping action）」——從產品上方往下，再往排氣口方向，將任何粒子帶離產品？
blocks.en: Does the airflow form a "sweeping action", moving from above the product downward and then toward the exhaust, carrying any particles away from the product?

blocks.zh: 操作員的手部動作是否破壞了 first air 的流向？
blocks.en: Do the operator's hand movements disrupt the direction of first air?

blocks.zh: 容器開口狀態下，有無亂流進入容器？
blocks.en: With containers open, is any turbulent air entering them?

blocks.zh: 比喻：工廠排煙罩（排氣罩）
blocks.en: Analogy: a fume extraction hood

blocks.zh: 廚房排油煙機的設計目標是讓油煙向上進入排氣管，而不是飄向廚師臉部。如果你點燃一根火柴，觀察煙霧軌跡，就能立刻判斷排氣罩是否正常運作。
blocks.en: A kitchen range hood is designed so that cooking fumes rise into the exhaust duct rather than drifting toward the cook's face. If you light a match and watch the path of the smoke, you can immediately tell whether the hood is working properly.

blocks.zh: 煙霧研究就是這個原理的藥廠版本：以煙霧代替油煙，以 HEPA 過濾器代替排氣管，確認「潔淨氣流是否真的往正確方向流動，保護產品而非污染它」。
blocks.en: A smoke study is the pharmaceutical version of this principle: smoke replaces cooking fumes and the HEPA filter replaces the exhaust duct, to confirm that "the clean airflow really moves in the right direction, protecting the product rather than contaminating it."

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — BSC 的差異與含量測試
blocks.en: Commentary: BSC Differences and Containment Testing

blocks.zh: 含量測試（Containment Testing）方法
blocks.en: Containment testing methods

blocks.zh: 除煙霧研究外，BSC 還可使用量化含量測試：
blocks.en: In addition to smoke studies, a BSC can be assessed with quantitative containment tests:

blocks.zh: KI-Discus 測試（EN 12469）：在 BSC 內釋放碘化鉀（KI）鹽粒，測量 BSC 外部（操作員區域）的濃度，計算保護係數（protection factor）。此為 BSC 生物安全性能的黃金標準測試。
blocks.en: KI-Discus test (EN 12469): potassium iodide (KI) salt particles are released inside the BSC and the concentration outside the BSC (in the operator's area) is measured to calculate the protection factor. This is the gold-standard test of a BSC's biosafety performance.

blocks.zh: 隔離測試（Segregation test, ISO 14644-3 §4.2.11）：在較低等級區域設定定濃度氣溶膠，測量受保護區域的濃度差，計算隔離因子（protection factor）
blocks.en: Segregation test (ISO 14644-3 §4.2.11): an aerosol of constant concentration is generated in the lower-classified area, and the concentration difference in the protected area is measured to calculate the protection factor

blocks.zh: 醇類擴散測試（Fume cupboard）：以定濃度酒精氣霧替代 KI，測量擬人假人兩側的濃度差
blocks.en: Alcohol dispersion test (fume cupboard): a constant-concentration alcohol vapor replaces KI, and the concentration difference on either side of an anthropomorphic dummy is measured

blocks.zh: 保護係數（Protection Factor）計算
blocks.en: Calculating the Protection Factor

blocks.zh:
保護係數 (PF) = 腔體內濃度 / 腔體外（操作員側）濃度

例如：
  腔體內 KI 濃度：10,000 顆粒/m³
  腔體外測量濃度：10 顆粒/m³
  PF = 10,000 / 10 = 1,000

EN 12469 要求 Class II BSC 的 PF ≥ 1×10⁵
（代表操作員暴露量 ≤ 腔體內的 1/100,000）

意義：PF 越高 = 操作員防護越好
ATMP 應用（高活性生物產品）通常要求更高 PF
blocks.en:
Protection factor (PF) = concentration inside the cabinet / concentration outside the cabinet (operator side)

Example:
  KI concentration inside the cabinet: 10,000 particles/m³
  Concentration measured outside the cabinet: 10 particles/m³
  PF = 10,000 / 10 = 1,000

EN 12469 requires a PF ≥ 1×10⁵ for a Class II BSC
(meaning operator exposure ≤ 1/100,000 of the concentration inside the cabinet)

Significance: higher PF = better operator protection
ATMP applications (highly potent biological products) usually require a higher PF

blocks.zh: 你的設施使用一台 Class II Type A2 BSC 處理含有腺病毒載體的 ATMP 產品（BSL-2）。年度資格確認（annual requalification）中，煙霧研究顯示操作員在進行轉移操作時，前臂的進入動作造成 sash 開口附近出現短暫的煙霧外逸趨勢。請回答：
blocks.en: Your facility uses a Class II Type A2 BSC to handle an ATMP product containing an adenoviral vector (BSL-2). During the annual requalification, the smoke study shows that when the operator performs a transfer, the forearm's entry movement causes a brief tendency for smoke to escape near the sash opening. Answer the following:

blocks.zh: 此觀察代表哪種風險——對產品、對操作員，還是兩者？請依 ATMP Decision Hierarchy 說明。
blocks.en: What risk does this observation represent: to the product, to the operator, or to both? Explain according to the ATMP Decision Hierarchy.

blocks.zh: 你會建議哪些立即矯正措施（immediate CAPAs）？
blocks.en: What immediate corrective actions (immediate CAPAs) would you recommend?

blocks.zh: 是否需要停止使用此 BSC？觸發停止的判斷標準是什麼？
blocks.en: Does use of this BSC need to be stopped? What are the criteria for deciding to stop?

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 常見失效模式與文件要求
blocks.en: Commentary: Common Failure Modes and Documentation Requirements

blocks.zh: 煙霧研究常見失效模式
blocks.en: Common failure modes of smoke studies

blocks.zh: 亂流（Turbulence）：大型設備（離心機、培養瓶）在腔體內產生氣流死角或回流，使粒子積累在產品附近
blocks.en: Turbulence: large equipment (centrifuges, culture flasks) inside the chamber creates dead zones or backflow in the airflow, so particles accumulate near the product

blocks.zh: 干預干擾：操作員快速移動手臂進入 BSC 時，帶入外部非潔淨空氣（room air intrusion）
blocks.en: Intervention disturbance: when the operator moves an arm quickly into the BSC, non-clean outside air is drawn in (room air intrusion)

blocks.zh: 遮蔽效應（Shadowing）：較大物件遮蔽下方產品，使 HEPA 的 first air 無法直接到達產品接觸表面
blocks.en: Shadowing: a larger object shades the product beneath it, so HEPA first air cannot reach the product-contact surfaces directly

blocks.zh: 氣流短路（Short-circuiting）：HEPA 出風口附近的氣流直接進入回風口，未能充分覆蓋工作區
blocks.en: Short-circuiting: airflow near the HEPA outlet goes straight into the return grille and does not adequately cover the work zone

blocks.zh: 外部擾動：相鄰設備（風扇、人員移動）產生的氣流干擾 BSC 的 inflow 氣簾
blocks.en: External disturbance: airflow produced by adjacent equipment (fans, personnel movement) disturbs the BSC's inflow air curtain

blocks.zh: 圖 5.3-1 KI-Discus 測試解析
blocks.en: Figure 5.3-1 KI-Discus Test

blocks.zh: KI-Discus 測試是量化評估 BSC 含量能力的標準方法。其測試邏輯：
blocks.en: The KI-Discus test is the standard method for quantitatively evaluating a BSC's containment capability. Its test logic:

blocks.zh: 腔體內釋放已知濃度的 KI 鹽粒（模擬危害物質）
blocks.en: Release KI salt particles of known concentration inside the cabinet (simulating a hazardous substance)

blocks.zh: 在操作員呼吸區測量 KI 濃度
blocks.en: Measure the KI concentration in the operator's breathing zone

blocks.zh: 計算保護係數（PF）
blocks.en: Calculate the protection factor (PF)

blocks.zh: 對 ATMP 設施而言，KI-Discus 測試結果直接支持操作員安全（Decision Hierarchy #1）的評估，特別是在處理 BSL-2/BSL-3 等級的病毒載體時。
blocks.en: For an ATMP facility, KI-Discus results directly support the assessment of operator safety (Decision Hierarchy #1), especially when handling viral vectors at BSL-2/BSL-3 level.

blocks.zh: 圖 5.3-2 酒精擴散測試解析
blocks.en: Figure 5.3-2 Alcohol Dispersion Test

blocks.zh: 醇類擴散測試使用動態假人手臂模擬操作員進行掃掠動作時的氣流干擾——這是最貼近真實操作員動作的測試條件。相較於 KI-Discus 的靜態測試，此方法更能捕捉動態操作中的含量性能。
blocks.en: The alcohol dispersion test uses a dynamic dummy arm to simulate the airflow disturbance caused by an operator's sweeping movements. This is the test condition closest to real operator movement. Compared with the static KI-Discus test, this method better captures containment performance during dynamic operation.

blocks.zh: 測試結果決定含量性能等級（Containment Performance Class），此等級直接影響設備是否適合特定危害等級的產品處理。
blocks.en: The test result determines the Containment Performance Class, which directly affects whether the equipment is suitable for handling products of a given hazard level.

blocks.zh: CFD（計算流體動力學）模擬是在建造設備前預測氣流的工具。煙霧研究與 CFD 模擬的關係是什麼？為什麼 CFD 預測「良好」的設計，在煙霧研究中仍可能出現問題？請舉一個具體例子說明。
blocks.en: CFD (computational fluid dynamics) simulation is a tool for predicting airflow before the equipment is built. What is the relationship between smoke studies and CFD simulation? Why can a design that CFD predicts as "good" still show problems in a smoke study? Give a specific example.

blocks.zh: 維持設施壓力梯度/壓力穩定性的方法 | pp. 52–53
blocks.en: Methods for maintaining facility pressure cascade/pressure stability | pp. 52–53

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 壓力量測方法
blocks.en: Commentary: Pressure Measurement Methods

blocks.zh: 壓力梯度（Pressure Cascade）的基本原理
blocks.en: Basic principle of the pressure cascade

blocks.zh: 潔淨室設施的壓力梯度設計使空氣永遠從高等級區（更潔淨）流向低等級區（較不潔淨），防止交叉污染。
blocks.en: The pressure cascade of a cleanroom facility is designed so that air always flows from the higher-grade (cleaner) area to the lower-grade (less clean) area, preventing cross-contamination.

blocks.zh: 正壓泡泡（Positive bubble）：核心無菌區相對周圍環境為正壓，確保任何洩漏方向都是從無菌區向外，而非向內
blocks.en: Positive bubble: the core aseptic area is at positive pressure relative to its surroundings, ensuring that any leakage runs from the aseptic area outward, not inward

blocks.zh: 負壓水槽（Negative sink）：危害物質處理區相對周圍為負壓，確保危害物質不逸散到鄰近區域
blocks.en: Negative sink: the hazardous-material handling area is at negative pressure relative to its surroundings, ensuring that hazardous materials do not escape into adjacent areas

blocks.zh: 壓力梯度（Cascade）：多個房間形成依次遞減的壓力序列，創造「單向逃逸路徑」
blocks.en: Cascade: multiple rooms form a sequence of successively decreasing pressures, creating a "one-way escape path"

blocks.zh: 兩種量測方法比較
blocks.en: Comparison of Two Measurement Methods

blocks.zh:
方法一：直接差壓量測
  測量：相鄰兩空間之間的直接壓差 (ΔP)
  公式：ΔP = P_高壓區 - P_低壓區 （由單一感測器直接測量）
  優點：反應速度快，直接反映壓差狀態
  缺點：每個相鄰對需要一個獨立感測器

  典型接受標準：
  Grade B vs. C：≥ 10–15 Pa
  Grade C vs. D：≥ 10–15 Pa
  Grade D vs. 外部：≥ 5–10 Pa

方法二：絕對壓力計算差壓
  測量：每個空間的絕對壓力 P_abs
  公式：ΔP_calculated = P_abs(A) - P_abs(B)
  優點：感測器數量少，可監測多房間的壓力整體狀況
  缺點：兩個感測器各有誤差，計算差壓的誤差為兩者之和
         → 對於小差壓（如 10 Pa）的量測，誤差影響較大
blocks.en:
Method 1: direct differential pressure measurement
  Measures: the direct pressure difference between two adjacent spaces (ΔP)
  Formula: ΔP = P_high-pressure area - P_low-pressure area (measured directly by a single sensor)
  Advantages: fast response, directly reflects the pressure differential status
  Disadvantages: each adjacent pair needs its own sensor

  Typical acceptance criteria:
  Grade B vs. C: ≥ 10–15 Pa
  Grade C vs. D: ≥ 10–15 Pa
  Grade D vs. outside: ≥ 5–10 Pa

Method 2: differential pressure calculated from absolute pressures
  Measures: the absolute pressure P_abs of each space
  Formula: ΔP_calculated = P_abs(A) - P_abs(B)
  Advantages: fewer sensors, can monitor the overall pressure status of multiple rooms
  Disadvantages: the two sensors each have their own error, so the error of the calculated differential
         is the sum of both
         → the error has a larger effect when measuring small differential pressures (e.g. 10 Pa)

blocks.zh: 圖 5.4-1 解析 — 隔離器腔體與供氣 HEPA 上方的差壓量測
blocks.en: Figure 5.4-1: Differential Pressure Measurement Above the Supply HEPA and in the Isolator Chamber

blocks.zh: 此圖展示了隔離器系統中兩個關鍵壓力量測點：
blocks.en: This figure shows two key pressure measurement points in an isolator system:

blocks.zh: P1（HEPA 上方）：空氣在通過供氣 HEPA 濾器之前的靜壓，反映送風系統的驅動壓力
blocks.en: P1 (above the HEPA): the static pressure of the air before it passes through the supply HEPA filter, reflecting the driving pressure of the air supply system

blocks.zh: P2（隔離器腔體內）：過濾後的潔淨空氣進入工作腔體的靜壓
blocks.en: P2 (inside the isolator chamber): the static pressure of the filtered clean air as it enters the working chamber

blocks.zh: 量測 P1 - P2 的差值（即 HEPA 的壓降），可以監測 HEPA 濾器的阻塞狀態——壓降逐漸升高代表 HEPA 負載增加，需要更換。這同時也是隔離器腔體維持設計壓力狀態的關鍵監測參數。
blocks.en: Measuring the difference P1 - P2 (i.e. the HEPA pressure drop) allows the loading state of the HEPA filter to be monitored: a gradually rising pressure drop indicates increasing HEPA loading and the need for replacement. It is also a key monitoring parameter for keeping the isolator chamber at its designed pressure.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 警報設計與壓力控制策略
blocks.en: Commentary: Alarm Design and Pressure Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 為什麼壓力穩定對 ATMP 尤為重要？
blocks.en: Why is pressure stability particularly important for ATMPs?

blocks.zh: ATMP 設施往往需要同時處理：
blocks.en: An ATMP facility often has to handle both of the following at the same time:

blocks.zh: 正壓無菌區：保護細胞產品（高活性藥物）免受環境污染
blocks.en: Positive-pressure aseptic areas: protect the cell product (a highly potent drug) from environmental contamination

blocks.zh: 負壓含量區：防止病毒載體（腺病毒、慢病毒）逸出傷害操作員
blocks.en: Negative-pressure containment areas: prevent viral vectors (adenovirus, lentivirus) from escaping and harming operators

blocks.zh: 這兩種區域共存於同一設施，壓力管理系統必須確保它們的壓差在任何操作狀態（包括門的開啟、人員進出）下都能維持。一旦壓力梯度崩潰，可能同時危及操作員安全（#1）和產品無菌性（#2）。
blocks.en: These two types of area coexist in the same facility, and the pressure management system must ensure that their pressure differentials are maintained in every operating state (including door openings and personnel entry and exit). If the pressure cascade collapses, it can jeopardize both operator safety (#1) and product sterility (#2).

blocks.zh: 警報延遲設計的合理性
blocks.en: Rationale for the alarm delay design

blocks.zh: 門的開啟必然造成短暫壓力波動。如果警報在每次門開啟的瞬間立刻觸發，操作員會因「警報疲勞（alarm fatigue）」而忽略真正的壓力失控事件。
blocks.en: Opening a door inevitably causes a brief pressure fluctuation. If the alarm is triggered the instant each door opens, operators will ignore genuine pressure excursions because of "alarm fatigue".

blocks.zh: 因此，警報延遲（alarm delay）的設計邏輯：
blocks.en: The logic behind the alarm delay design is therefore:

blocks.zh: 延遲 = 允許正常操作引起的短暫波動消散的時間
blocks.en: Delay = the time allowed for brief fluctuations caused by normal operations to dissipate

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-14 設定上限：延遲 < 3 分鐘
blocks.en: PDA PtC-14 sets an upper limit: delay < 3 minutes

blocks.zh: 延遲設定必須以風險評估支撐，並納入 CCS（污染控制策略）文件
blocks.en: The delay setting must be supported by a risk assessment and included in the CCS (contamination control strategy) documentation

blocks.zh: 若超過 3 分鐘延遲，從壓力失控到警報觸發之間的時間視窗過長，可能已在無菌區域發生難以偵測的污染事件。
blocks.en: If the delay exceeds 3 minutes, the window between the loss of pressure control and the alarm is too long, and a contamination event that is difficult to detect may already have occurred in the aseptic area.

blocks.zh: 比喻：大樓防火門的壓差系統
blocks.en: Analogy: the differential pressure system of a building's fire doors

blocks.zh: 高樓火災時，逃生梯間通常維持正壓，防止煙霧進入。這個加壓系統設計必須在火災警報觸發後幾秒內啟動，且必須承受人員頻繁開門帶來的壓力衝擊。
blocks.en: In a high-rise fire, the escape stairwell is usually kept at positive pressure to keep smoke out. This pressurization system must start within seconds of the fire alarm and must withstand the pressure shocks caused by people frequently opening the doors.

blocks.zh: ATMP 潔淨室壓力控制與此原理相同：需要快速響應（fast-acting pressure control dampers）、允許短暫波動（門的開關）、但不能容忍持續壓力失控。
blocks.en: ATMP cleanroom pressure control follows the same principle: it needs fast response (fast-acting pressure control dampers), tolerates brief fluctuations (doors opening and closing), but cannot tolerate sustained loss of pressure control.

blocks.zh: 壓力控制系統設計框架
blocks.en: Pressure Control System Design Framework

blocks.zh:
CCS（污染控制策略）壓力參數典型設定：

  正常操作範圍（Action level 前）：
    目標差壓：15 Pa（Grade B vs. Grade C）
    警告限度（Alert limit）：10 Pa
    行動限度（Action limit）：<8 Pa（持續超過警報延遲時間）

  警報延遲時間：
    建議：30 秒 ~ 120 秒（依門的開關頻率調整）
    上限：< 3 分鐘（PDA PtC-14 要求）

  AHU 響應時間：
    壓力偏差偵測後 → AHU 調整 → 壓力恢復
    要求：AHU 響應時間 < 警報延遲時間（確保自動恢復）

  氣鎖門聯鎖（Door interlock）：
    同一時間只能開啟一扇門
    → 防止壓力梯度在人員進出時完全崩潰
blocks.en:
Typical CCS (contamination control strategy) pressure parameter settings:

  Normal operating range (before the action level):
    Target differential pressure: 15 Pa (Grade B vs. Grade C)
    Alert limit: 10 Pa
    Action limit: <8 Pa (sustained beyond the alarm delay time)

  Alarm delay time:
    Recommended: 30 s to 120 s (adjusted to the frequency of door openings)
    Upper limit: < 3 minutes (PDA PtC-14 requirement)

  AHU response time:
    Pressure deviation detected → AHU adjusts → pressure recovers
    Requirement: AHU response time < alarm delay time (to ensure automatic recovery)

  Airlock door interlock:
    Only one door can be open at a time
    → prevents the pressure cascade from collapsing completely during personnel entry and exit

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在設計一個新的 ATMP 生產套房，包含：Grade B 隔離器操作間（正壓）、外部緩衝走廊（Grade C）、以及一個需要處理 BSL-2 慢病毒載體的 BSC 操作間（負壓含量）。請回答：
blocks.en: Your CDMO is designing a new ATMP production suite that includes: a grade B isolator operating room (positive pressure), an external buffer corridor (grade C), and a BSC operating room for handling a BSL-2 lentiviral vector (negative-pressure containment). Answer the following:

blocks.zh: 為這兩個操作間（正壓無菌區、負壓含量區）設計壓力梯度序列，並說明氣鎖的功能（sink、bubble 還是 cascade？）。
blocks.en: Design the pressure cascade sequence for the two operating rooms (positive-pressure aseptic area, negative-pressure containment area), and explain the function of the airlock (sink, bubble or cascade?).

blocks.zh: 你會選擇直接差壓量測（Method 1）還是絕對壓力計算法（Method 2）？理由是什麼？
blocks.en: Would you choose direct differential pressure measurement (Method 1) or the absolute pressure calculation method (Method 2)? What is your reasoning?

blocks.zh: 若監控系統顯示正壓無菌間的壓差持續低於行動限度 5 分鐘，且 AHU 已自動響應但未能恢復，你的處置程序為何？對正在進行中的批次有何影響？
blocks.en: If the monitoring system shows that the differential pressure of the positive-pressure aseptic room has stayed below the action limit for 5 minutes, and the AHU has responded automatically but failed to restore it, what is your response procedure? What is the impact on the batch in progress?

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-14 Complete Section Summary — 全文五大主題總結
blocks.en: PDA PtC-14 Complete Section Summary: Summary of the Five Topics

blocks.zh: 主題一：範疇、決策層次、ATMPs 特殊性、BSL 等級架構
blocks.en: Topic 1: Scope, decision hierarchy, ATMP specifics, BSL level framework

blocks.zh: 主題二：BSC 分類、Grade B 背景、NSF/ANSI 49、first air 原則
blocks.en: Topic 2: BSC classification, grade B background, NSF/ANSI 49, first air principle

blocks.zh: 主題三：隔離器類型、VHP 去污、手套管理、RTP、生命週期成本
blocks.en: Topic 3: Isolator types, VHP decontamination, glove management, RTP, lifecycle cost

blocks.zh: 主題四：設施佈局、潔淨室等級、壓力梯度、PAL/MAL 氣鎖、多產品分隔
blocks.en: Topic 4: Facility layout, cleanroom grades, pressure cascade, PAL/MAL airlocks, multi-product segregation

blocks.zh: 主題五：Mock-up 三類型 | 洩漏測試頻率差異 | 煙霧研究目標差異 | 壓力梯度量測與警報管理
blocks.en: Topic 5: Three types of mock-up | Differences in leak test frequency | Differences in smoke study objectives | Pressure cascade measurement and alarm management

blocks.zh:
PDA PtC-14 的核心命題：ATMP 設施設計必須同時實現操作員含量保護（BSL 驅動）與產品無菌保證（GMP 驅動）。
                所有技術決策均服從同一決策層次：操作員安全優先，患者安全其次。
blocks.en:
The core proposition of PDA PtC-14: ATMP facility design must achieve both operator containment protection (BSL-driven) and product sterility assurance (GMP-driven).
                All technical decisions follow the same decision hierarchy: operator safety first, patient safety second.
